name: Can I remove an old shower stall to build an accessible or curbless shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove an old shower stall to build an accessible or curbless shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an old, cramped, or leaking shower stall can be removed and converted into a larger walk-in shower or an accessible roll-in unit. Removing the existing unit exposes the floor structure, allowing adjustments to the subfloor height, framing for built-in shower niches or benches, and the installation of backing for ADA grab bars. A curbless or barrier-free shower also requires a specific drain slope and waterproof pan installation, making the tear-out phase essential for establishing proper clearances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Demolition reveals the framing and subfloor needed to reinforce backing for grab bars, install curbless pans, and adjust plumbing for accessibility.
